scope: auth recovery and isolated enrollment qualification
implementation: Reused resolve_auth, CookieJar.reread, _check_cookie_identity, _send, isolated PKCE helpers and existing refresh/CAS persistence; no new HTTP or credential owner.
recover_browser_auth explicitly validates the original source, preserves pinned account/org, rolls back failure, and does not replay an action or consume any grant.
scripts/claude-rc-auth provides on-demand recover and explicit enrollment with an owned Chrome CDP tab, optional Playwright, bounded wait, sanitized failures and no automatic consent clicks.

PKCE rejects blank duplicate state/code, OAuth error callbacks, fragments, nonmatching Unicode state and malformed successful grant payloads. Consumed/expired is rechecked inside the enrollment lock so concurrent failed attempts cannot exchange twice.
Installed Claude Code 2.1.312 authorization URL/client/scope literals were rechecked. Prior group01 upstream/community and ownership research was reused, not replaced by another auth implementation.

offline_verification.focused_command: uv --directory <worktree> run --extra test --extra web --extra cli pytest -q tests/auth_recovery_test.py tests/test_auth.py
offline_verification.full_command: uv --directory <worktree> run --extra test --extra web --extra cli --with playwright pytest -q
offline_verification.owned_refresh_qualification: Offline MockTransport: secure mode-0600 persistence, restart with rotated token, thread and POSIX-process concurrent refresh adopt one CAS exchange. Not server token replacement proof.

verification_limitations: The first browser inspection selected two body nodes due an injected DOM; it failed at locator strictness. Using the first body fixed the verifier; this was not a service auth failure.
No independent OAuth code/grant was obtained. Owned token replacement, owned-grant restart and concurrent server refresh were not run; no shared grant was copied or substituted.
The auth page changed the browser cookie snapshot. Which cookie changed was not measured; do not claim browser-session rotation or unchanged browser cookies.
Natural month-scale expiry, revocation recovery, Chrome DB extraction, trusted-device enrollment and macOS/Windows lock execution are not qualified by this run.
